name: print-social-indigo-and-golden-pollen-two-colour-name-post
title: Space Indigo and Golden Pollen Colour Post
whatItIs: A portrait post split into a deep indigo upper half with yellow 'Space Indigo #1F2041' and a golden yellow lower half with indigo 'Golden Pollen #F5D35C', hex codes in outlined pills and a handle strip at the top.
whatItMeans: Each colour is the other's text colour, so the pairing proves itself, and the names add poetry.

vocabulary.definition: A descriptive name given to a colour.
An outlined label holding a colour code.
Two colours used as each other's foreground and background.
